set.body: Commit 9a59b5ff on fix/laws-chunk-ar-determinism-20261003 added private[ar] scalafim.fmri.ar.ExactSum, a portable fixed-point exact accumulator for doubles (70 carry-save base-2^32 Long digits in units of 2^-1074, single nearest-even rounding, IEEE non-finite channel). It makes pooled AR lag sums chunk-invariant. This is generic numerics and belongs in Gale. Task: land it upstream as a superaccumulator under gale.numeric (with its ExactSumSuite and the BigInteger reference property), then on the next galeRevision bump switch modules/ar to the Gale type and delete modules/ar/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/ar/ExactSum.scala and its suite.
set.title: Upstream ExactSum superaccumulator to gale.numeric
